name: Member Gateway - Google Forms durable source adapter (inactive)
description: DO NOT ACTIVATE. Inactive, manual-only Google Forms source adapter for the XB member gateway. Each run begins or resumes one gateway scan epoch bound to the fixed production cutover, then runs a bounded manual page loop: fetch one response page, open the page durably, obtain one accepted or PII-free rejected handling receipt per item, and commit the page. createTime is forwarded verbatim. Progress lives only in the gateway; nothing is stored in n8n staticData. Credentials, the Form, the gateway origin and question IDs are bound only in a separately reviewed deployment copy.

nodes.name: Repository-safe source configuration
nodes.notes: Inactive placeholders only. Form, gateway origin, source bearer, and question IDs are bound in a separately reviewed deployment copy.

nodes.name: Controlled activation gate
nodes.notes: False in source control. Repository checkout has no continuous trigger or scheduling authority.

nodes.name: Blocked until separate activation
nodes.notes: Safe false branch emits synthetic metadata and performs no network operation.

nodes.name: Begin or resume scan epoch
nodes.notes: Resumes the one ACTIVE epoch or begins one from the fixed production cutover. Idempotent, so bounded retry is safe.

nodes.name: Plan epoch attempt
nodes.notes: Validates cursor v2. An open page from a crashed attempt restarts the epoch; a consumed first_member allowance stops without fetching.

nodes.name: Restart crashed scan epoch
nodes.notes: CAS restart from the same fixed cutover. No automatic retry.

nodes.name: Prepare page request
nodes.notes: Bounded manual page loop entry. Progress is durable in the gateway epoch, never in n8n staticData.

nodes.name: Google Forms single page (configured outside repo)
nodes.notes: One response per page, verbatim fixed-cutover filter, epoch-scoped opaque token. Built-in pagination is not used because it cannot interleave the durable open/receipt/commit steps.

nodes.name: Canonicalize source page
nodes.notes: Closed question mapping. createTime is forwarded verbatim; there is no sorting, ordering assertion or Date re-serialisation.

nodes.name: Restart invalidated scan epoch
nodes.notes: Only a positively classified unusable page token restarts. No automatic retry.

nodes.name: Open page durably
nodes.notes: OPEN persists the request/next token and item identities before the epoch token can move. No automatic retry.

nodes.name: Page item is a valid member
Protected XB Gateway ingest (configured outside repo)
nodes.notes: Receipt-driven admission. A matching prior receipt replays; any conflict stops before commit.

nodes.name: Page item is a customer rejection
Record PII-free source rejection
nodes.notes: Carries only the fingerprint and a customer-validation code. Does not consume the first_member allowance.

nodes.name: Commit durable page checkpoint
nodes.notes: CAS commit succeeds only when every page item has a matching durable receipt. No automatic retry.

nodes.name: Plan next page
nodes.notes: Stops on a completed epoch, a committed first_member member page, or the per-run page budget.
